title: Case: Recipient disputes a recorded failed delivery attempt
context: A failed-attempt scan is disputed. The carrier must review its record without assuming the customer or driver is dishonest.
initial_request: I was at home and did not hear the intercom. Please review the missed attempt and arrange another visit. I am available on 2027-02-14 morning.

events.body: DL-8868 has a failed-attempt scan at 08:40 UTC today. The route record has not yet been reviewed; no conclusion about the attempt is available.
I was at home and did not hear the intercom. Please review the missed attempt and arrange another visit. I am available on 2027-02-14 morning.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Dispatch review team, Pebblewick Arc Logistics
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask dispatch to review the attempt record and arrange a new attempt.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Pebblewick Arc Logistics that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask dispatch to review the attempt record and arrange a new attempt. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: A corrected stop error is not proof of fraud; the replacement attempt remains pending.
expected.reference_message: Review DL-8868’s failed-attempt record against the delivery stop, and arrange an available repeat attempt on 2027-02-14 morning. Please report the review finding rather than infer fault.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-013: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
